description_en: Queries the information about a migration task
description_zh: 调用GetMigrationSummary，获取导入导出任务的信息
name: GetMigrationSummary

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The migration task ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780280.html operation to obtain the ID of the import task and call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780281.html operation to obtain the ID of the export task
parameters.help_zh:
导入导出任务的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780280.html接口获取导入任务的ID，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780281.html接口获取导出任务的ID
parameters.name: migration_id

Data.description_en: The details of the migration task
Data.description_zh: 请求返回的导入导出任务详情

CreateUser.description_en: The ID of the user who created the task

DownloadUrl.description_en: The URL that is used to download the package of the export task. You can use the URL to download the package of the export task
DownloadUrl.description_zh: 导出任务包的下载链接。您可以通过该链接下载导出任务

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the task was created

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the task was modified

OpUser.description_en: The ID of the user who managed the task

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace to which the migration task belongs

Status.description_en:
The status of the migration task. Valid values:

INIT
EDITING
IMPORTING
IMPORT_ERROR
IMPORT_SUCCESS
EXPORTING
EXPORT_ERROR
EXPORT_SUCCESS
REVOKED
PARTIAL_SUCCESS
Status.description_zh:
导入导出任务的执行状态。取值如下：
INIT：任务为初始状态。
EDITING：任务在编辑中。
IMPORTING：任务在导入中。
IMPORT_ERROR：任务导入失败。
IMPORT_SUCCESS：任务导入成功。
EXPORTING：任务在导出中。
EXPORT_ERROR：任务导出失败。
EXPORT_SUCCESS：任务导出成功。
REVOKED：任务被取消。
PARTIAL_SUCCESS：仅部分任务导入或导出成功

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the request ID to query logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。取值如下：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败。您可以通过请求ID定位问题
